snippet.title: Mrat Fright Trailer
snippet.description: Mrat Fright is a fast-paced arcade search-and-capture adventure where you screech to light up the pitch-black underground, hunt elusive rats, and dodge hidden hazards before time runs out. Play the free demo or full game on itch.io: https://terrytproduction.itch.io/mratfright
